title: Chintamani Library v2.8.14 — Portal Repair, Fast Updater & Package Conflict Fix
releaseNotes: UNIVERSAL QR PORTAL PERMANENT REPAIR: Fixed undefined payment page error after admission. Registration, payment proofs, complaints, and feedback now persist directly to the database.
DIRECT HIGH-SPEED UPDATER: Fixed 'connecting to server' timeout with immediate streaming, 15s adaptive timeout, multi-architecture fallback, and 1-tap direct browser download.
PACKAGE SIGNATURE CONFLICT FIX: Guidance added for Android signature mismatches; all release APKs signed with permanent canonical keystore.
ADMIN PORTAL REAL-TIME SYNC: Payment screenshots and new member registrations immediately visible in Payment Verification and Admission queue.
